subject: SS
title: Pharaoh and government officials
teach: The pharaoh was Egypt’s ruler. Egyptians regarded the pharaoh as divine, or connected with godly authority. The pharaoh made laws, defended Egypt and collected taxes, including wheat.
The pharaoh relied on officials. The vizier was a trusted chief adviser and chief judge. The chief treasurer collected taxes. The general of armies directed the military.

A bureaucracy is a system of government offices and officials. Different officials carried out different jobs for the pharaoh. Match an official to the job, rather than assuming the pharaoh did every task alone.
